_comment: DISABLED BY DEFAULT. Nothing runs unless this file says enabled=true AND the environment sets WATCHTOWER_SCHEDULER_ENABLED=1, AND the source's policy gate passes (approved, current, robots-compliant, real WATCHTOWER_CONTACT). This file never installs a cron job or service; an operator may call `python -m watchtower.cli schedule run-due` from their own scheduler once they have approved doing so. See docs/SCHEDULING.md.
